dateBasis: Australia/Brisbane calendar days; targetDate requires exact YYYY-MM-DD
cohort: All visible non-fictional cases and events captured at asOf; no terminal-status inference
refresh: Native views are live; cross-list files are frozen local/manual projections

measures.label: Missing role or next action; unconfirmed target dates
measures.missing: blank role/action and non-ISO target text reported separately; no inferred assignment

measures.label: Recorded target dates before as-of date
measures.denominator: cases with qualified ISO target dates
measures.missing: pending or malformed date text excluded and counted as unconfirmed

measures.label: Age since case creation
measures.denominator: cases with valid nonfuture Created dates
measures.missing: unknown; not stage turnaround or active working time

measures.label: Cases with validated readiness or assurance history
measures.missing: no valid events means no recorded history, never a completed stage

measures.label: Recorded ready-for-decision finding to linked recorded decision
measures.denominator: valid explicit ReadinessEventUID pairs for same case/document/version/hash
measures.missing: not measurable when no qualified pairs

measures.label: Recorded decision to linked recorded publication event
measures.denominator: valid explicit ParentEventUID pairs with Decision parent and Publication child
measures.missing: not measurable when no qualified pairs

measures.label: Recorded implementation to linked recorded verification event
measures.denominator: valid explicit ParentEventUID pairs with Implementation parent and Verification child
measures.missing: not measurable when no qualified pairs; result success is not inferred

stageRules: Recorded assertions only; dates come from AssessedOn/OccurredOn, never Created. Same case/document/version/hash required. Pending, not-applicable, fictional, invalid, future, negative or ambiguous pairs are excluded with reasons. Every explicit pair is a sample; repeated case episodes are not silently collapsed.
